measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

applications.name: Twin (twin-world's own callers)
applications.client: the runtime's boot (packages/world-runtime), posting the descriptor's credentialDoor

backend.call: the runtime asks a World's tinybird twin for the application's token at boot (the descriptor's credentialDoor: POST /_twin/app-credentials), filling TINYBIRD_API_KEY and TINYBIRD_TOKEN

applications.client: @chronark/zod-bird 1.0.0 (apps/web/package.json:30, pnpm-lock.yaml:1589; Tinybird({ token: TINYBIRD_API_KEY, baseUrl: TINYBIRD_API_URL }) at apps/web/lib/tinybird/client.ts:3) and fetch

backend.call: a click recorded by the redirect handler: POST /v0/events?name=dub_click_events&wait=true with the admin token as a Bearer, by fetch
the Framer leads backfill cron appends clicks: POST /v0/events?name=dub_click_events&wait=true, by fetch

a click recorded for a program application (app/(ee)/api/track/application/route.ts:274): tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_click_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_click_events&wait=true
each link made, changed or deleted: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_links_metadata", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_links_metadata&wait=true
a lead: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_lead_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_lead_events&wait=true
a lead with its own timestamp: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_lead_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_lead_events&wait=true
a sale: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_sale_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_sale_events&wait=true
a sale with its own timestamp: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_sale_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_sale_events&wait=true
a webhook Dub delivered: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_webhook_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_webhook_events&wait=true
a postback Dub sent: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_postback_events", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_postback_events&wait=true
an audit log entry: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_audit_logs", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_audit_logs&wait=true
an API request logged: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_api_logs", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_api_logs&wait=true
an import error: tb.buildIngestEndpoint({ datasource: "dub_import_error_logs", wait: true }), which POSTs the events as NDJSON to /v0/events?name=dub_import_error_logs&wait=true
